title: OpenSheaf timestamps extension: the owner's declaration, version 0.1
$comment: Proposal (OpenSheaf timestamps 0.1, extension https://opensheaf.org/opensheaf-timestamps-0.1). The value of extensions["https://opensheaf.org/opensheaf-timestamps-0.1"] in keys.json; the entry, even empty, declares that the owner timestamps every signature it makes. Dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0.

timestampAuthorities.$comment: SHA-256 fingerprints of the signing or root certificates of RFC 3161 authorities; a signature file trusts those listed in the key-log version it names and in the versions before it, and a date earlier than that key-log version's own does not count
